fr_respirer_verb.hook: On the little pier by the fountain, Monsieur Verbe RESTS on the PIER and BREATHES the fresh hill air, arms wide (rehs-pih-RAY).
fr_respirer_verb.why: Respire / rest on a pier → respirer = to breathe.

fr_inspirer_verb.hook: A sunbeam strikes Monsieur Verbe at his easel: he BREATHES IN deeply and is INSPIRED (ans-pih-RAY).
fr_inspirer_verb.why: Inspire → inspirer = to inspire; to breathe in.

fr_demeurer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the DEMURE statue REMAINS perfectly still on his plinth – even the butterfly stays (duh-muh-RAY).
fr_demeurer_verb.why: Demure → demeurer = to remain, stay; also to live (somewhere).

fr_vivre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe looks after his sunflower so it can LIVE – 'VIVE la fleur!' (VEEVR).
fr_vivre_verb.why: Vive! / vivid → vivre = to live. Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_souffler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BLOWS on his hot SOUFFLÉ to cool it (soo-FLAY).

fr_mourir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the museum guide points to the plaque on the wall: mourir = to die (moo-REER).
fr_mourir_verb.why: Shown only as a museum plaque, nothing drawn; 'MORE EAR' – the guide cups his ear for more → mourir = to die. Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_coiffer_verb.hook: Hairdresser Monsieur Verbe DOES the poodle's HAIR into a towering curl, like a COIF (kwah-FAY).
fr_coiffer_verb.why: Coif / coiffure → coiffer = to do someone's hair.

fr_fatiguer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe is TIRED OUT: FATIGUED on the bench with a steaming white cup of TEA (fah-tee-GAY).

fr_piquer_verb.hook: A PICKY wasp STINGS only Monsieur Verbe's jam sandwich (pih-KAY)!
fr_piquer_verb.why: Picky / pick → piquer = to sting, to prick.

fr_calmer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe CALMS himself DOWN: eyes closed, slow breaths, his hand mirror in his hand (kahl-MAY).
fr_calmer_verb.why: Calm → se calmer = to calm down; the hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se).

fr_fumer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the museum guide points to the plaque on the wall: fumer = to smoke, like an old chimney (few-MAY).
fr_fumer_verb.why: Shown only as a museum plaque, nothing drawn; FUMES → fumer = to smoke, like a chimney.

fr_tuer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the museum guide points to the second plaque on the wall: tuer (TWAY).
fr_tuer_verb.why: Shown only as a museum plaque, nothing drawn; tuer le temps = to pass the time; only the plaque shows the word.
ex: Il lit pour tuer le temps.
He reads to pass the time.

fr_souffrir_verb.hook: Under his own little snow cloud Monsieur Verbe SUFFERS from the cold – SO FREEZING (soo-FREER)!
fr_souffrir_verb.why: Suffer / 'so freeze' → souffrir = to suffer. Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_blesser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the museum guide, hand mirror at his side, points to the plaque on the wall: se blesser = to hurt oneself, to get injured (bleh-SAY).
fr_blesser_verb.why: Shown only as a museum plaque, nothing drawn; not 'bless'! se blesser = to hurt oneself; the hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se).

fr_traiter_verb.hook: Doctor Monsieur Verbe TREATS the teddy bear, his tools laid out on a silver TRAY (tray-TAY).

fr_soigner_verb.hook: Nurse Monsieur Verbe LOOKS AFTER the little duckling with a tiny bandage while the SWAN watches (swah-NYAY).
fr_soigner_verb.why: 'Swan-yay' → soigner = to look after, to care for, to treat.

fr_couronner_verb.hook: The pigeon COOS as Monsieur Verbe CROWNS it with a little crown (koo-roh-NAY).

fr_sacrer_verb.hook: In the little chapel Monsieur Verbe solemnly raises the SACRED crown – a king will be CROWNED here (sah-KRAY).
fr_sacrer_verb.why: Sacred → sacrer = to crown, consecrate (a king, a bishop).

fr_cracher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SPITS a cherry stone – CRASH! – into the tin bucket (krah-SHAY).

fr_avaler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SWALLOWS a whole wobbly jelly in one gulp, like swallowing A VALLEY (ah-vah-LAY).

fr_cligner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe WINKS – one eye CLICKS shut (klee-NYAY): cligner de l'œil = to wink.
fr_cligner_verb.why: Click → cligner = to blink; cligner de l'œil = to wink.

fr_etouffer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the museum guide points to the plaque on the wall: étouffer = to suffocate, to stifle (ay-too-FAY).
fr_etouffer_verb.why: Shown only as a museum plaque, nothing drawn; sticky TOFFEES stuck together → étouffer = to suffocate, stifle (also: it's stifling hot).

fr_saigner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the museum guide points to the second plaque on the wall: saigner = to bleed (seh-NYAY).
fr_saigner_verb.why: Shown only as a museum plaque, nothing drawn; 'SAY NAY to tears' – a plaster fixes it → saigner = to bleed.

fr_mordre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BITES a big chunk out of the huge apple and wants MORE (MORDR).
fr_mordre_verb.why: More / mordant → mordre = to bite. -re verb: PURPLE beret.
